documents.content: COMPLIANCE POLICY CP-VR-2026: Contracts in the Vendor Risk category exceeding $25,000 require BOTH Director financial approval AND a separate Legal risk sign-off before execution. Director approval alone, without a documented Legal sign-off, does not constitute execution authorization for this category.

Subject: Ashgrove Vendor Risk Partners contract. Approving the $30,000 Ashgrove Vendor Risk Partners (VENDOR-6005) engagement from a financial standpoint -- within my Director authority. Legal review is still pending on my end; flagging that separately. -- T. Osei, Director.
